newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MIXED ON KEY UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MIXED ON KEY UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar ended Friday's interbank session mixed on major currencies, little changed on the U.S. dollar, weaker on sterling but firmer on the mark and the rand.
Foreign exchange dealers said the central bank came in when the local unit appreciated to 11.3650 on the U.S. dollar earlier in the day on the back of an influx of tobacco export receipts.
"The Reserve Bank came in heavily and took out some Z$11 million so the Zimdollar came back a bit and stabilisied around 11.3750," one dealer said.
Towards Friday's close, the Zimbabwe dollar was quoted at 11.3750/3850 -- a level which dealers said the central bank seemed happy with -- versus its 11.3785/3885 late Thursday position.
It was indicated at 19.0240/0500 on sterling from 19.0100/0300, at 6.3240/3300 against the mark versus 6.3600/3640 and at 2.4940/5000 against the rand compared to 2.4985/4995.
